answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the quartz count is verified against the ledge text itself, the garden audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 37 aliases hence means producing 37 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
